mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the tightening signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% within the last month signals a strengthening labor market, which increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive labor signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real estate sales by more than 5% within the last two months signals a strengthening housing market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive housing signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 1% within the last two months signals a weakening supply chain, which reduces corporate output and earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative supply signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 over the last three months signals a robust labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances with strong payroll growth.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) and a falling real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals a demand crunch, which reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increase > 0.5% and RSAFS decrease > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the demand crunch signal.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) and a low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4%) signals a tight labor market with high borrowing costs, which constrains corporate investments and earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the tight monetary and labor conditions.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 2% over the last quarter signals a strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances with strong GDP growth.
